title: Inputs
doc: Speed, gear and the pedal traces side by side.

title: Position & gaps
doc: Position in class, gaps to the car ahead and behind.

title: Relative
doc: The cars physically nearest you on track, not on the timesheet.

title: Standings
doc: The full field, sorted the way race control sorts it.

title: My car
doc: Which car you are in: badge and model name.

title: Head 2 head
doc: You against one rival — the gap and the best-lap difference.

title: Laptime graph
doc: Every lap as a bar, coloured by pace.

title: Delta trace
doc: A rolling trace of your delta to the best lap.

title: Laptime spread
doc: Where your laps cluster, and which ones are outliers.

title: H. standings
doc: The field as a horizontal strip of driver cards.

title: Laptime log
doc: A table of laps: number, time, delta, track temperature.

title: Blind spot
doc: Two wide bars at the screen edges when a car sits alongside.

title: Corner losses
doc: The three corners where the last lap lost the most time.

title: Sectors
doc: Where this lap is up or down, sector by sector.

title: Fuel & pit
doc: Fuel left, burn rate and what the next stop needs.

title: Laps
doc: Last, best and predicted lap — and the gaps between them.

title: Race bar
doc: A one-line HUD: gear, shift lights, delta and fuel.

title: Delta to best
doc: Delta to your best lap, in one large number.

title: RPM & shift
doc: Revs and the moment to pull the next gear.

title: G-force
doc: Lateral and longitudinal load as a moving dot.

title: Top speed
doc: Speed now, best this lap and best this session.

title: Slip
doc: Not just that the car is sliding — which end is sliding.

title: Position trend
doc: How your position moved across the race.

title: Session summary
doc: The session in one card: position, pace, consistency, incidents.

title: Tire temps
doc: Tyre temperature across three zones of every wheel.

title: Tire wear
doc: Remaining tread, per wheel and per zone.

title: Session
doc: What session this is and how much of it is left.

title: Delta to record
doc: Your track record and how far off it you are today.

title: ERS / hybrid
doc: Hybrid charge and how fast you are spending it.

title: Weather
doc: Air and track temperature, wind, humidity, time of day.

title: Flags
doc: Flags as they are shown, plus the ones already waved.

title: Radar
doc: Cars around you drawn from above, at close range.

title: Track map
doc: The circuit drawn from your own laps, with the field on it.

title: Optimal lap
doc: The lap you could have driven from your best sectors.

title: Pit helper
doc: Pit lane: limiter, speed and where the box is.

title: Sensors & balance
doc: How you work the pedals, measured over the stint.

title: Delta bar
doc: Delta to best as a bar you can read without focusing.

title: Wear graph
doc: Tyre wear over the stint, as a line per wheel.

title: Spotter
doc: Spotter calls in text: car left, car right, three wide.

title: Weather radar
doc: Rain approaching the circuit, and how soon.

title: Driver & stint
doc: Who is in the car and how long this stint has run.

title: Time left
doc: Time left in the race, big, with a progress bar.

title: Team incidents
doc: Incident count for the whole team, not just you.

title: Symptoms
doc: What the car does on entry, mid-corner and exit.

title: Front/rear balance
doc: Heat balance front to rear — and the setup change it asks for.

title: Wear trend
doc: How fast the tyres are going away, and how much is left.
